🚔 East New York (2022–2023) — Crime / Drama
East New York follows Deputy Inspector Regina Haywood and the officers and detectives of the 74th Precinct in Brooklyn. After taking command, Haywood introduces new ideas for protecting the community while dealing with officers who are hesitant about her approach.
As the team investigates crimes and responds to problems throughout the neighborhood, they also navigate personal conflicts, community relationships, and the challenges of working together.
The series explores community, leadership, justice, teamwork, trust, and personal growth.
